result.summary: Fixes mining RPC handling when createNewBlock() returns nullptr on node shutdown. Instead of failing a CHECK_NONFATAL assertion and reporting an internal bug, getblocktemplate and generateblock throw a standard RPC_CLIENT_NOT_CONNECTED ("Shutting down") error, and generateBlocks stops mining cleanly.
result.problem: When getblocktemplate or generateblock is executed or waiting on longpoll during node shutdown, createNewBlock() returns nullptr. Previously, CHECK_NONFATAL treated this benign shutdown condition as an internal bug.
